    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # draw concentric square rings in colors 4 and 2 around that center.

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The interior 3 is the seed. From it, concentric square layers alternate

    occupied = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The interior 3 is the seed. From it, concentric square layers alternate
    # colors 4 and 2; each layer is clipped to the interior of the 3 frame.
    occupied = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in occupied), max(r for r, c in occupied)
    left, right = min(c for r, c in occupied), max(c for r, c in occupied)
    seeds = [(r, c) for r, c in occupied if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
    if not seeds:
        return out
    sr, sc = seeds[0]
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            d = max(abs(r - sr), abs(c - sc))
            if d > 0:
                out[r][c] = 4 if d % 2 else 2
    return out
